title: Clear Workplace Communication

questions.explanation: After 'could you', use the base verb 'clarify'. 'Clarification' is a noun.
questions.hint: Read each option as a complete sentence before choosing.

questions.prompt: So far, we've ___ the first draft.
questions.explanation: 'We've' means 'we have'. Use the past participle 'finished' after 'have'.
questions.hint: Read each option as a complete sentence before choosing.

questions.explanation: 'On track' means progress is following the plan; the work may still be unfinished.
questions.hint: Read each option as a complete sentence before choosing.

options: I'll take care of the report.
questions.explanation: Use 'take care of + task'. The word 'of' is part of the expression.
questions.hint: Read each option as a complete sentence before choosing.

questions.explanation: 'To sum things up' introduces a summary. 'By the way' introduces another topic.
questions.hint: Read each option as a complete sentence before choosing.

application.prompt: Imagine a short team meeting. Describe what is done, what remains, and the next step.
checklist: I used a useful expression from these lessons.
I compared the meaning with the example; my wording can be different.
application.modelResponse: So far, we've finished the draft. We still need to check the figures. I'll take care of that tomorrow and send an update before lunch.

completionRule: Attempt all five questions and review explanations

introduction.en: Review how to ask for clarification, give an update, assign responsibility, and summarize.
introduction.taglish: Balikan ang polite questions, updates, responsibilities, at summaries.
introduction.fil: Balikan ang paghingi ng paglilinaw, pagbibigay ng ulat, paghahati ng gawain, at pagbubuod.
